subject: Offer 2025 on the annual map with HR-VPP 2024, clearly labelled
description: HR-VPP 2025 is not published for any of our 20 tiles (WEkEO, 2026-11-03). A control showed that HR-VPP from y-1 changes a median 6.8 % of pixels (max 10.2 %, noise floor 0). Tobias decided on 2026-11-03 to offer 2025 with HR-VPP 2024, clearly labelled. Scope: an explicit year table {2025: 2024} in imint/inference/lclu.py; provenance and result carry vpp_year and vpp_year_substituted; the catalogue carries the notice; preparation, staging, preflight and the acceptance audit (qualified_substituted_vpp) follow the table; the page shows '2025 · växtfenologi från 2024' with the note. Release r11 is created after review on Tobias's go (PVC expanded to 800Gi for its sources). Not in scope: r11 itself, re-pinning the 2024 batch to r11 (follow-up). Review: Codex.
